description: This source file contains unit tests for the HostEnvSanitizer utility, which sanitizes environment variable overrides and inspects override keys potentially blocked or invalid. The tests validate behavior such as sanitizing shell trace variables, allowing only explicit override keys, maintaining regular overrides outside shell context, blocking dangerous keys, and handling Windows-style key names.

methods.name: sanitize blocks shell trace variables
methods.description: Tests that the sanitizer correctly removes shell trace variables like SHELLOPTS, PS4, and ensures OPENCLAW_TEST remains if explicitly set.

methods.name: sanitize shell wrapper allows only explicit override keys
methods.description: Verifies that only specified override keys are permitted when shellWrapper mode is enabled, blocking others such as OPENCLAW_TOKEN and PS4.

methods.name: sanitize non shell wrapper keeps regular overrides
methods.description: Checks that overrides provided without shell context are preserved.

methods.name: inspect overrides rejects blocked and invalid keys
methods.description: Ensures that the inspector identifies blocked keys like CLASSPATH and invalid keys like BAD-KEY.

methods.name: sanitize accepts Windows-style override key names
methods.description: Tests that Windows-style environment variable keys such as ProgramFiles(x86) are accepted and preserved.
